features.quote: Termination Conditions: 1. Max turns (30). 2. Keyword detection ("I give up", specific exit codes). 3. Repetition penalty trigger (3 identical consecutive actions).
To minimize cost per run, the harness injects "compressed" errors. Instead of full stack traces (which consume input tokens), the harness returns minimal, high-frustration signals
The 16k output limit allows the model to "crater" fully, which is the signal we are hunting for.
features.justification_quote: We need to capture the full degradation curve.
